chunk.content: Eleutheronema tetradactylum is not known from East Asia, where it is replaced by the endemic congener Eleutheronema rhadinum, a similar threadfin species.
chunk.source_quote: The species is not known from East Asia (where it is replaced by the endemic E. rhadinum).

source.title: Threadfins of the World (Family Polynemidae), FAO Species Catalogue for Fishery Purposes No. 3 (Motomura, 2004), Eleutheronema accounts
source.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
